subject: general
question: A hollow spherical shell is made of a metal of density 2.5 g/cm³. If the external and the internal radii of the given sphere are 35 cm and 14 cm, respectively, find the mass of the shell. [Use pi=(22)/(7) ]
solution:
**Given:**

Density = 2.5 g/cm3 

Inner Radius (r) = 14 cm

Outer Radius (R) = 35 cm 

**Formula used:**

Volume of hollow sphere = (4)/(3) π (R³ - r³)

Volume = (Mass)/(Density)

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

Volume = (4)/(3) π (353 - 143)

⇒ (Mass)/(Density) = {(( 4)/(3))}× ((22)/(7)) × (42875 - 2744)

⇒ Mass = 2.5 × [((4)/(3))× ((22)/(7)) × (40131)]

⇒ Mass = 2.5 × [(4) × (22) × (1911)]

⇒ Mass = 2.5 × 168168 = 420420 g

**∴ The mass of the shell is 420420 g.**
